image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a classic car wheel featuring a chrome wire-spoke rim and a whitewall tire. The wheel is mounted on a light green vehicle fender. The rim has a prominent central spinner hubcap and intricate wire spokes radiating outward. The tire shows a distinct white sidewall band and black tread area.
